verdict.rationale: Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new pull request in selected repos or org-wide, with no configuration and no cap ('Unlimited AI Reviews'). Custom rules and comment exclusions let teams tune the bar, and a dashboard tracks issues found, acceptance rates and PRs reviewed. GT MCP also splits large AI-generated changes into smaller stacked PRs that are easier to review. Missing for 10: no documentation of handling aimed specifically at agent-authored PRs, no evidence of catch rate or accuracy at high volume, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality.
